luci-app-saadway.description: SaadWay lifecycle page for LuCI (Constitution Principle V strict dual-UI decoupling): grants the LuCI session exactly the two saadway.* lifecycle methods used by the view — service status display and enable/disable toggle, plus the open-dashboard link. No configuration surface. On stock OpenWrt the default rpcd login section for 'root' lists groups '*' (rpcd.config), so this permission group is attached automatically to LuCI root sessions; nothing to configure in /etc/config/rpcd.
